name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strikes hit several Ukrainian regions into 19 Nov, after energy attacks in three regions on 18 Nov
state: Zaporizhzhia's regional head said Russian forces made 554 strikes on 50 settlements in the 24 hours to 19 Nov, killing one and injuring six; drones hit a market in Kharkiv oblast, injuring 13, and 99 Mykolaiv settlements briefly lost power (Censor.net, 19 Nov). In the day to 18 Nov, attacks killed five and injured 15 and damaged energy sites in Kyiv, Mykolaiv and Rivne oblasts (Kyiv Independent). Sustained mass strikes on infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure can affect power supplies across the country during winter.
rubric_hit: Alert: sustained mass strikes on energy infrastructure across several regions
